implementation.feature: Canopy geometry.vertexY defines a planar underside, with top vertices offset vertically by thickness and closed edge faces following the plane; identical triangulation preserves shared polygon edges and supplied heights.
implementation.invalidInputs: Mismatched counts, non-numeric/non-finite values, collinear polygons, and non-planar elevations are rejected rather than flattened.
implementation.scope: Pitched vertexY is currently accepted for plaster canopies with fascia=0 (the requested measured source soffit). Horizontal behavior when vertexY is omitted remains unchanged.
implementation.collider: collider=false skips KCol entirely; collider=true adds the top surface collider.

lowLightMaterial.use: colour=gypsumLit and topFinish=gypsumLit for downward-facing upper plaster without baked GI

results: non-planar fourth height rejected at 0.0001 m tolerance

test.previewNote: The isolated preview shifts UV by +400 m to avoid current-scene occlusion; same edge vectors and absolute vertexY. gypsumLit on both colour and topFinish produced a continuous moderate-gray underside without auxiliary lights or white-hot emission.
